definitions.gloss: manufacturing method, production method, recipe, process
definitions.explanation: The specific method or technique used to make or produce something, from food and beverages to industrial products.

examples.japanese: ⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な{製法|せいほう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧だ。
examples.english: This is soy sauce made using traditional methods.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{製法|せいほう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{変|か}わっていない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: This production method hasn't changed since the Edo period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{製法|せいほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}した→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧ことで、⟦コスト→コスト：06666_kosuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{削減|さくげん}する→削減する：25399_sakugensuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: By introducing a new manufacturing method, we were able to significantly reduce costs.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used when discussing how things are made, especially food, crafts, and industrial products. Often appears in advertising and product descriptions to emphasize quality or tradition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な{製法|せいほう}: traditional production method
- ⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{製法|せいほう}: unique/proprietary method
- {製法|せいほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to preserve a production method
- {製法|せいほう}⟦{特許|とっきょ}→特許：13467_tokkyo⟧: manufacturing patent
